command:
set -euo pipefail
TDP_STORE="$HOME/repos/touristic-digital-platform.git"
git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" fetch origin main
test "$(git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "d979b9813c1ab40b96dee64616b9f7d08a7c0d07"
TDP_BUNDLE_PATH="$(mktemp "$HOME/.cache/tdp-coverage-material.XXXXXX.bundle")"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$TDP_BUNDLE_PATH"
test "$(sha256sum "$TDP_BUNDLE_PATH" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "760dacad1cc955fb401c8add75a0f1542311613e82897a7f787384692745b9dc"
git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" bundle verify "$TDP_BUNDLE_PATH"
git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" fetch "$TDP_BUNDLE_PATH" HEAD
test "$(git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "fc089a1fcef27e3c39f3c3d27faf4f69b088436b"
TDP_CURRENT_MAIN="$(git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" ls-remote origin refs/heads/main)"
test "${TDP_CURRENT_MAIN%%[[:space:]]*}" = "d979b9813c1ab40b96dee64616b9f7d08a7c0d07"
TDP_EXISTING_BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" ls-remote origin refs/heads/chore/journey-audit-coverage-admission-20261031)"
test -z "$TDP_EXISTING_BRANCH"
git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/chore/journey-audit-coverage-admission-20261031: origin fc089a1fcef27e3c39f3c3d27faf4f69b088436b:refs/heads/chore/journey-audit-coverage-admission-20261031
TDP_PUSHED_BRANCH="$(git --git-dir="$TDP_STORE" ls-remote origin refs/heads/chore/journey-audit-coverage-admission-20261031)"
test "${TDP_PUSHED_BRANCH%%[[:space:]]*}" = "fc089a1fcef27e3c39f3c3d27faf4f69b088436b"
printf '%s\n' "$TDP_PUSHED_BRANCH"
